apps.name: Manotu
apps.localizedDescription: Open-source community navigation for Malaysia. Favourites, recent places and planned drives stay on your phone. This sideload preview uses file backups; iCloud and Google Drive sign-in are unavailable. Requires AltStore Classic or Sideloadly. Free Apple accounts need a refresh every seven days.

versions.localizedDescription: Compact place card with ratings, big 'Still closed?' buttons, sound selector (Full, Alerts only, Mute). Your location is sent only when you ask for a route.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Manotu uses the camera so you can add photos of places and reviews.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Manotu keeps using your location while you navigate with the screen off, so voice guidance and traffic reports keep working.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Manotu uses your location to show where you are, find places near you and guide you turn by turn.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Manotu can save photos you choose to your library.
